purpose: Target and acquired registry of Telangana Police SI / Constable previous-year question papers. Registration records intent to acquire; it is not a claim that any paper has been read or any question extracted.
notes: Acquisition is complete for the nine local files enumerated under source_material/pyq_raw/. Each is verified by SHA-256 and recorded here as a COACHING_COPY (no board-host source was reachable from this environment).

Extraction is NOT complete: only the 2016 Preliminary and 2016 General Studies papers have a usable text layer and were fully extracted (200 questions each). The other seven are image-only scans or watermark-only; with the available English-only OCR they cannot be reliably extracted, so they are registered as retrieved with normalized_questions_status NONE and an extraction_caveat.
